title: jmap: implement Thread/get
description: Why: Thread/get (RFC 8621 §4.3) is a core JMAP Mail method. Thunderbird and most JMAP clients use Thread/get to group messages into conversation threads. Articles in usenet already carry In-Reply-To and References headers, making threading natural. Without Thread/get, JMAP clients cannot display threaded conversations. What: Implement handle_thread_get(). A Thread object contains {id: String, emailIds: Vec<String>}. Thread ID should be the CID of the earliest known ancestor in the thread (walk References/In-Reply-To chain via the overview index, take the root). For articles with no In-Reply-To, the thread ID equals the article CID. Wire into route_method() as Thread/get.
